description: OddsTrader’s own published numbers for one NBA, NFL or NHL game or over/under player prop, labelled as OddsTrader’s (not BSD’s): for a game, its predicted final score (total and home margin) and its moneyline, spread and total picks with line, price, cover chance (fraction), expected value and 0-5 rating; for a prop, its consensus line against its projection (and which side the projection leans to), and each side’s cover chance at OddsTrader’s own line, expected value, rating and season cover record. Best price and book are a detail. Name the league and a team (optionally the opponent), or a player and the prop type. Optional side and line (and gameMarket for a game) say whether your bet is OddsTrader’s exact side and line: only then is a cover chance given for it. A game that cannot be matched exactly returns found false, never a near match. Readings are at most 10 minutes old (5 within an hour of the start); started games return only the last reading saved before the start, marked as such. OddsTrader’s numbers never change a BSD Grade.
name: get_oddstrader_reading
title: Read OddsTrader’s numbers
